name: camdahl-code-editor
description: CodeMirror 6 bundle for CodeBlock's code field in the Wagtail admin. Build output is committed to blog/static/blog/code-editor.js.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2020 --legal-comments=none "--banner:js=/* Built from blog/static_src/code-editor (npm run build). Includes CodeMirror 6, MIT licensed, https://codemirror.net */" --outfile=../../static/blog/code-editor.js
